# velora-log-viewer

Log Viewer is a useful tool for viewing system logs.

- Repository: <https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-log-viewer>
- License: `GPL-3.0-or-later`

## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.7)`, `project(deepin_log_viewer)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
```

The top-level script has no `install()` rule, so build artifacts stay in `build/`.
